manufacturer.name: Boss (Garage Door Operators)
manufacturer.note: Australian garage door operator brand. No manufacturer website or documentation index surfaced - every source below is a reseller. Name collision worth flagging: searching "Boss SD-1 owner's manual" surfaces boss.info, which is Roland's Boss, and the SD-1 there is a guitar pedal. Nothing from boss.info is recorded here, and a Boss opener model code must be matched against a garage-door source before it is trusted.

documents.title: Boss BOL04 Setup Instructions

Neither the document nor the page has been opened, so its presence at this URL, its edition and its contents are all unconfirmed. Treat as a lead, not a citation, until manuals:verify has run against it. Not fetched - egress blocked.

documents.title: Boss BOL4 Garage Door Operator Manual

documents.evidence: Reseller copy. The document covers coding a handset and names no specific handset model, so the record carries no model code beyond the generic one - inventing a part number to make it look precise would be worse than the vagueness. Not fetched - egress blocked.
